card.title: Nintendo Switch No fan spin and not charging joycons Repair

source.title: Nintendo Switch No fan spin and not charging joycons Repair

claims.statement: The fan and Joy-Con rails share one MOSFET just north of M92T36; when it fails open the fan stops and Joy-Cons won't charge.
Try the voltage injection trick first; otherwise replace the MOSFET or a bad fan.

procedure: Try voltage injection on fan VCC.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
